Two use cases — same platform

A 4-star hotel — 80 rooms

The manager receives reviews from Google, Booking and TripAdvisor but doesn't know which department is underperforming. Overall score: 4.2 — everything seems fine.

After 3 months of TextIQ + VisualIQ + PredictIQ analysis:

  • 68% of negative mentions relate to corridor noise between 11pm and 1am — never flagged to management
  • VisualIQ detects on customer photos that 3 rooms on the 2nd floor systematically show mold in the bathroom
  • Corporate clients mentioning 'Wi-Fi' in their reviews are 4× more likely not to renew
  • 3-month trend: breakfast satisfaction score up from 61% to 79% after menu change

FAQ

Which review platforms do you cover?

Google Reviews, Booking, TripAdvisor, and any CSV export from your PMS or CRM. We retrieve reviews directly on request (free up to 100).

How do customers send their photos?

Via any existing channel — email, WhatsApp, complaint form, or review platform. You collect them, we analyze them.

Can you analyze reviews in several languages?

Yes — 5 native languages: EN, FR, DE, ES, PT-BR. No translation layer — each language is processed natively for maximum accuracy.

You have reviews and photos sitting unread?

Send us your last 100 reviews — full analysis in 48 hours. Free. No credit card.
